name: News, Front Pages
description: Today's newspaper front pages from the Freedom Forum archive, one paper per render, filling the cell's width from the top. Rotates through the papers listed under Settings → Widgets → News, Front Pages, or shows one pinned paper. The rotation moves on at most once every four minutes, so a send prepared ahead of time and its follow-ups show one paper; that approximates one paper per shown frame, and two sends within four minutes repeat a paper. Pages download in the background, and the last good page stays up while a paper isn't out yet. No API key needed.

cell_options.name: paper
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: One paper every time, or the next paper from the list in the widget's settings on each render.

settings.name: papers
settings.label: Papers
settings.help: Freedom Forum paper codes to rotate through, one per line, in order. Start a line with # to skip that paper. A number after a code trims that percent off the top of the page, for the printer's slug line some papers carry.
